title: Made an arena shooter with Codex where the gun doesn't matter, only your movement does
author: synap5e
selftext:
Been messing around with this thing called Gridwake, kind of a Geometry Wars vibe. Turret just auto-aims and shoots on its own, so honestly the gun barely matters, all you're doing is steering. Your ship leaves a trail behind it though, and if you loop back through your own trail it closes a loop and wipes out whatever's caught inside. So most of the fun ends up being luring enemies into a spot then cutting them off with your own path.

Had Codex do the heavy lifting on gameplay, enemy behavior, refits, UI, testing, that kind of thing. Opus 5 did the ship model.
